opportunities.point: The company targets an overall EBITDA margin of 14.5% to 16% in the future.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We would like to take it our overall business to 16%, 15% EBITDA level. I'm talking about 14.5% plus." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects the stainless steel business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores EBITDA and the SBQ business to contribute INR1,000 crores EBITDA by FY31.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "By FY31, we expect this business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores EBITDA from stainless steel and INR1,000 crores EBITDA from SBQ business, respectively." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company is investing INR2,700 crores in an expansion at the Odisha plant for stainless steel, scheduled for commissioning by March 2029.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Stainless steel represents our other significant opportunity where we are diversifying by investing INR2,700 crores expansion in our Odisha plant, with complete downstream processing capability together is scheduled both to be commissioned target by March..." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to deploy the balance capex of approximately INR8,864 crores over the next 2 to 3 years.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The balance planned capex of approximately INR8,864 crores is expected to be deployed over the next 2 to 3 years, and which is also through our internal accrual, and which is also in line with the project execution timelines." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: A capital goods tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Global steel demand is projected to be flat in 2026, with 1.7% growth in 2027, while Indian demand is expected to increase by 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The World Steel Association October outlook projected broadly flat global steel demand in 2026, followed by 1.7% growth in 2027. India remains the major source of growth with the demand expected to increase 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Medium-to-long term prospects for the metal industry look extremely constructive and positive.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "However, medium-to-long term look extremely constructive and positive, supported by infrastructure spending, smart manufacturing growth, renewables and infra housing and all these sectors." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Total sales volume increased by 26% year-on-year to 15.49 lakh tons in Q2 FY27.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The total sales volume increased by 26% on year-on basis to 15.49 lakh tons in quarter 2 of the current financial year" (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted they have order bookings for almost close to more than 10 months from their existing foil plant.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We are already in the business. We have a lot of order booking. We have almost close to more than 10 months order bookings from our existing foil plant." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects to commission the 1.6 million ton HR mill and other projects to reach over 70-80% revenue from value-added products.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "But I can tell you in next 2 years from now, we should be able to do more than 75%, close to 70% or 80% from value added" (concall transcript - 2026-11-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Production from the Phutamura coal block is expected to start in July 2027.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Production expected from July 2027." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01) [July 2027]

opportunities.point: Foreign institutions have been building a position.
